CA.rationale: Content (red set) is explicitly bound to a processing/origin condition (command_estimate) for the same referent/time.

COD.rationale: Content (red set), organization/presentation (origin) and a distinct status flag (executed_branch_claim=false) are all explicitly provided for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: A processing/origin condition (command_estimate/feedback_through) is explicitly linked to the named content referent.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified content sets labeled by color for named referents and a current time.

D.rationale: A distinct status attribute (executed_branch_claim=false) is provided separately from the content sets for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The report specifies presentation layout and origin/representation-kind fields describing how named contents are organized/presented for a referent/time.
